AdminAccounting.title: Accounting
AdminAccounting.intro: Double-entry books: accounts, financial periods, the journal, expenses, income and reports.
AdminAccounting.disclaimer: This accounting structure is a technical foundation. Have it reviewed by a qualified Iranian accountant before relying on it for tax or legal reporting.

About.title: About us
About.description: Clicksp Spare Parts is an online store for genuine motorcycle parts and accessories, with fitment checks for your model and delivery across Iran.
About.headline: The right part for your motorcycle
About.intro: We sell motorcycle spare parts and accessories with exact part numbers and fitment information, so you buy a part that really fits your bike, without guesswork.

genuine.title: Genuine, quality parts
genuine.text: We source parts from trusted suppliers and show each item's brand and origin clearly.

fitment.title: Fitment checked
fitment.text: Every part lists the motorcycle models and years it fits, so you don't order the wrong one.

shipping.title: Delivery across Iran
shipping.text: Orders are packed safely and shipped to every city in the country.

support.title: Expert advice
support.text: Not sure which part you need? Our team will help you before you buy.

story.p1: Clicksp Spare Parts started with a simple goal: finding the right part for a motorcycle shouldn't be hard, slow or full of guesswork. Many riders visit several shops for a simple brake pad or oil filter and still aren't sure it fits their bike.
story.p2: We organise our catalogue by manufacturer part number and compatible models, so once you choose your motorcycle you only see parts made for it. From engine and brake parts to electrical items, oil, filters and accessories, everything comes with a clear price and real stock.
story.p3: We believe trust is built on honesty. That's why we describe every item accurately, answer your questions before you buy, and stay with you after the sale.

range.brakes: Brake pads, discs and brake system parts
range.consumables: Oil, filters, spark plugs and consumables

About.ctaText: Get in touch and we'll help you find the right part for your bike.
